zh.title: 土耳其東部 Sikorsky S-70 直升機墜毀，4名軍人死亡
zh.summary: Sikorsky S-70直升機在Malatya墜毀，4名土耳其軍人死亡。
body: 土耳其國防部表示，2026年11月12日，一架軍用 Sikorsky S-70 直升機在土耳其東部 Malatya 郊區墜毀，4名土耳其軍人死亡。當地媒體報導，直升機約於當地時間18時45分在 Malatya 的 Yeşilyurt 區一處街區墜落；警方、消防人員和醫療團隊到場應對。
國防部表示，事故原因尚未確定。Malatya 首席檢察官辦公室已就墜機事件展開調查；土耳其 Anadolu Agency 報導，一名副首席檢察官和兩名檢察官獲派負責此案。

en.title: Four Turkish service members killed in military Sikorsky S-70 helicopter crash near Malatya
en.summary: A military Sikorsky S-70 helicopter crashed near Malatya; four Turkish service members died.
body: Turkey’s Defense Ministry said four Turkish service members died when a military Sikorsky S-70 helicopter crashed on the outskirts of Malatya in eastern Turkey on November 12, 2026. Local media reported that the helicopter came down at about 18:45 local time in a neighborhood in Malatya’s Yeşilyurt district. Police, firefighters and medical teams responded to the crash.

The Defense Ministry said it had yet to determine the cause. The Malatya chief public prosecutor’s office opened an investigation into the crash. Turkey’s Anadolu Agency reported that a deputy chief prosecutor and two prosecutors had been assigned to the case.
